title: Autonomously discover tools for a bounded graph counterexample
prompt: Challenge the claim that every connected triangle-free simple graph on exactly 7 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 is bipartite. If false, return one explicit counterexample and exact values for order, size, connected, bipartite, minimum_degree, maximum_degree, triangle_count, and independence_number. Set conclusion to FALSE exactly when the supplied graph is a counterexample. This is a bounded construction task, not a proof about larger graphs.
